cases.sentence: После того, как Давид поселился в своем ___, он сказал пророку Нафану.
cases.translation: After David settled in his palace, he said to the prophet Nathan.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Смотри, я живу во ___ из кедра, а ковчег Господнего Завета стоит под шатром.
cases.translation: Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the Lord's covenant is in a tent.
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) with a location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я не жил в ___ с того дня, как вывел израилетян из Египта и до сегодняшнего дня.
cases.translation: I have not lived in a house since the day I brought Israel out of Egypt until this day.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я взял тебя, когда ты смотрел и ухаживал на пастбище за ___, чтобы ты стал правителем моего народа Израиля.
cases.translation: I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition за (following/after) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я был с тобой, куда бы ты ни ходил, и сокрушил перед тобой твоего ___.
cases.translation: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off your enemy from before you.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb сокрушил (cut off) stands in the accusative case.

cases.translation: I will establish his throne forever.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb упрочу (establish) stands in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я не отниму от него своей милости, как отнял ее от твоего ___.
cases.translation: I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from the one who was before you.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Тогда царь Давид вошел, сел перед Господом и сказал, «Кто я, Господи Боже, и что такое моя ___, что ты так возвеличил меня?»
cases.translation: Then King David went in and sat before Yahweh, and said, 'Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?'
cases.explain: The subject of the understood verb stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: После того, как Давид поселился в своем дворце, он сказал пророку Нафану, «Смотри, я живу во дворце из кедра, а ковчег Господнего Завета стоит под шатром».
reading.question: What did David point out to the prophet Nathan?
options: That he lived in a cedar palace while the ark of the covenant was under a tent
That he wanted to build a new palace
That he needed the prophet's blessing
That the tent was too old
reading.correct: That he lived in a cedar palace while the ark of the covenant was under a tent
reading.explain: я живу во дворце из кедра, а ковчег Господнего Завета стоит под шатром.

reading.ru: Я взял тебя, когда ты смотрел и ухаживал на пастбище за овцами, чтобы ты стал правителем моего народа Израиля.
reading.question: How did God describe taking David from his former occupation?
options: From following sheep in the pasture to be prince over Israel
From the city to be a judge
From the temple to be a priest
From the army to be a general
reading.correct: From following sheep in the pasture to be prince over Israel
reading.explain: Я взял тебя, когда ты смотрел и ухаживал на пастбище за овцами, чтобы ты стал правителем.

reading.ru: Я устрою место для своего народа Израиля и укореню его, чтобы ему иметь свой дом и никто его больше не тревожил.
reading.question: What did God promise to do for Israel?
options: Appoint a place for Israel, plant them so they could have their own home and no one would bother them
Make them rulers over other nations
Provide them with chariots and weapons
reading.correct: Appoint a place for Israel, plant them so they could have their own home and no one would bother them
reading.explain: Я устрою место для своего народа Израиля и укореню его, чтобы ему иметь свой дом.

reading.ru: Он построит мне дом, и я упрочу его престол навеки.
reading.question: What did God promise David's son would do?
options: Build a house for God and have his throne established forever
Lead a rebellion against foreign powers
reading.correct: Build a house for God and have his throne established forever
reading.explain: Он построит мне дом, и я упрочу его престол навеки.

reading.ru: Кто я, Господи Боже, и что такое моя семья, что ты так возвеличил меня?
reading.question: What does David ask the Lord about himself after receiving these promises?
options: Who he is and what his house is that God has exalted him so greatly
Whether he should build a temple
How many enemies he would defeat
reading.correct: Who he is and what his house is that God has exalted him so greatly
reading.explain: Кто я, Господи Боже, и что такое моя семья, что ты так возвеличил меня?

reading.ru: Господи, нет подобного Тебе, и нет Бога, кроме Тебя, как слышали мы своими ушами.
reading.question: What does David affirm about God in his prayer?
options: That there is no one like the Lord and no God besides Him, as they have heard
That God should be feared above all things
That God is remote and distant
reading.correct: That there is no one like the Lord and no God besides Him, as they have heard
reading.explain: Господи, нет подобного Тебе, и нет Бога, кроме Тебя.
